subject: Activation playbook: SLAs, retention windows, and SOC 2 checkpoints
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@praxisfinancial.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@praxisfinancial.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Activation path & security checkpoints for Q4 close

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the Dedicated option. We have a compressed procurement window and are working to finalize both commercial terms and the security gating checklist by the end of Q3. To get to an internal buy decision we need a tight mutual action plan that:

- Lists acceptance checkpoints for SOC 2 evidence and SIG/CAIQ review cadence
- Confirms DPA redline status and expected turnaround on our edits
- Clarifies data retention tiers (session logs, full request payloads, embeddings) and any export options
- Aligns on SLA expectations for token-level throughput during our pilot

Can you send an activation-playbook style MAP with owner names, deliverable dates, and call out any must-have items for Legal/Security? We’re trying to avoid back-and-forth that would push this into November.

Appreciate it —
Maya
Head of Data & Integrations
Praxis Financial

--
Attachment: procurement_timeline_stub.pdf (pdf - stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@praxisfinancial.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@praxisfinancial.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation path & security checkpoints for Q4 close

Hi Maya,

Thanks — attached is a compact MAP we can iterate on. High level: we separate commercial close (sales/legal) from security acceptance (security/compliance), and propose parallel tracks so your procurement can sign while security runs the evidence sprint. Key asks below.

Quick highlights:
- SOC 2: we can provide our latest report + an evidence index. We expect the SIG/CAIQ review to take ~7 business days once we hand over the index and access to the questionnaire.
- DPA: I’ve appended our standard redline; expect Legal turn on our side within 3 business days of receiving your edits.
- Retention: default out-of-the-box retention tiers: session traces (30 days), request payloads (90 days), embeddings (90 days); we can offer a 30/90/365 custom profile for enterprise customers with a contract commitment.
- SLA: proposed pilot SLO: p99 latency <= 200ms for 512-token generations, sustained throughput aligned with a Dedicated 4-GPU pool.

Next steps: please review attached MAP and confirm which items Praxis wants prioritized for an accelerated close. Rachel (cc) will own evidence intake and can schedule a 30-min walkthrough for SIG/CAIQ.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: rdw-compact-map-v1.xlsx (xlsx - stub)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@praxisfinancial.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation path & security checkpoints for Q4 close

Hi Maya — looping in Jordan for the pilot SLA questions. I wanted to call out concrete items we'll need to hit your acceptance criteria and proposed timelines we can commit to if we start evidence intake next week: 

1) SOC 2 evidence intake
- Deliverable: soc2-evidence-index.csv (maps control -> sample artifacts)
- Owner: Rachel Kim (Redwood) / Maya Patel (Praxis)
- Target: 7 calendar days after intake kickoff for index delivery; 10 business days for your Security to validate samples

2) SIG/CAIQ questionnaire
- Deliverable: completed CAIQ export + controlled walk-through session
- Owner: Rachel Kim
- Target: CAIQ export within 3 business days of intake; review session scheduled within 7 business days

3) DPA redline and retention windows
- Deliverable: dpa-redline-v3.docx (we can accept most common carveouts; anything outside standard must be flagged as negotiation item)
- Owner: Legal (Praxis) / Ben Carter (commercial)
- Target: redline returned within 5 business days to keep timeline tight

4) Pilot SLA and throughput validation
- Deliverable: pilot runbook + throughput report (hand-off to engineering)
- Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood)
- Target: test run within 10 business days of contract signature; 3 business days to generate a pilot throughput report

If Praxis needs shorter windows, note where additional SOW or premium support will accelerate (e.g., dedicated evidence ingestion slot, overnight CAIQ mapping). We can commit to the above with start-of-intake by Oct 4.

I attached the evidence index and the DPA redline we discussed. If you confirm intake kickoff, I’ll send a calendar invite for the SIG/CAIQ walkthrough and a secure ShareDrive folder for artifacts.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Liaison, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: soc2-evidence-index.csv (csv - stub)
Attachment: dpa-redline-v3.docx (docx - stub)
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@praxisfinancial.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation path & security checkpoints for Q4 close

Thanks — this is exactly what our Security and Legal wanted to see. A couple of clarifying points before we kick off: 

- Can you confirm whether session traces include redacted PII by default or if that requires configuration? We need to ensure no raw PII remains in logs for pilot.
- For the CAIQ review, will Redwood provide a controlled demo environment (read-only) or do we need direct access to your console?
- If we return DPA redline by Oct 6, can you still meet the Oct 21 target for contract signature on your side?

If you can answer those three, we’ll confirm intake kickoff for Oct 4 and assign owners on our side.

Best,
Maya
Head of Data & Integrations
Praxis Financial
